pathways.title: Upstream • synthesis
pathways.context: Mouse epidermis after tape stripping; expression and HA accumulation. No fitted synthesis kinetics here.

pathways.title: Upstream • turnover
pathways.context: Human and bovine chondrocytes. Weak activity at near-neutral pH under study conditions; oral turnover remains unknown.
pathways.measure: HYAL activity, pH, HA size distribution

pathways.title: HA • differentiation
pathways.context: Cultured human keratinocytes and mouse epidermis. Oral-barrier translation and numerical gain are assumptions.
pathways.measure: Permeability, differentiation markers and lipid secretion

pathways.title: HA • junctional machinery
pathways.context: Mechanistic context discussed in the cited primary paper; this chain is not separately integrated as kinetic equations.
pathways.measure: Calcium dynamics, junctional localization, actin organization

pathways.title: HA • proliferation
pathways.context: Aged mouse skin: increased proliferation did not by itself restore permeability barrier repair.

pathways.title: HA • stromal migration
pathways.context: Rhamm knockout fibroblasts and mouse skin wounds; cell-context-specific evidence.

pathways.title: HA • matrix effectors
pathways.context: Aged mouse dermal wounds. Associations with receptor transcripts do not establish every intervening causal edge.
pathways.measure: Collagen III content and wound closure

pathways.title: HA • immune modulation
pathways.context: Mouse macrophages and septic-response model; requires the tested sequence and context.
pathways.measure: A20, IL-6, TNF and pretreatment timing

pathways.title: HA • size is not a verdict
pathways.context: Rat wound model: 6-mer helped closure; 40 kDa inhibited closure. Do not generalize small=harmful or large=helpful.

pathways.title: HA • challenge the premise
pathways.context: Endotoxin-free HA and fragments did not activate the tested inflammatory readouts. Contaminants can change the interpretation.
pathways.measure: Endotoxin assay, purified HA, matched vehicle

pathways.title: OMV • epithelial effectors
pathways.context: OBA-9 human gingival epithelial cell line; pathway inhibition supports involvement. No cytokine concentration is predicted here.
pathways.measure: pERK, pJNK, pp38, IL-6 and IL-8

pathways.title: OMV • intracellular sensing
pathways.context: STING siRNA reduced OMV-induced readouts; the complete DNA-delivery sequence is not measured in this scene.

pathways.title: OMV • lipid A signaling
pathways.context: P. gingivalis vesicles differ from parental outer membrane in tested lipid A composition; strain and conditions matter.

pathways.title: OMV • protease effects
pathways.context: Human U937-derived macrophages: inhibiting gingipains increased several cytokines but decreased TNF. No one-direction inflammation rule.
pathways.measure: Protease activity with specific inhibition and cytokine panel

pathways.title: Plaque • host mineralization
pathways.context: Bovine VSMC-derived vesicles under calcifying conditions. Distinct origin and function from a bacterial OMV.
pathways.measure: Origin markers, ALP activity, annexins, mineral assay

pathways.title: Plaque • calcifying host EVs
pathways.context: In vitro causal perturbations plus human carotid plaque associations. This is a host EV branch, not OMV conversion.
pathways.measure: Host EV markers, MMP7, ALP and calcium deposition

vesicle.identity: One synthetic, literature-informed exemplar. No claim that all displayed cargo was co-measured in one real particle.

properties.name: Diameter
properties.note: Control-preparation NTA mean 168.2 ± 8.7 nm in this study. The exemplar diameter is a chosen value, not a measured single-particle diameter.

properties.name: Membrane
properties.value: One lipid bilayer; 5 nm illustrative thickness
properties.note: Outer-membrane-derived bleb. Not a double-membrane bacterium.

properties.name: Surface charge
properties.value: Negative in the reference preparation; magnitude unassigned
properties.note: Depends on buffer and preparation; zeta potential is not a fixed material constant.

properties.name: Medium
properties.value: 310 K, viscosity 1 mPa·s, tissue mobility factor 0.25
properties.note: Stokes–Einstein estimate; not a measured tissue diffusion coefficient.

properties.name: Cargo counts / mass / density
properties.value: Unmeasured; no molecular copy numbers assigned
properties.note: Glyphs identify cargo classes, not their stoichiometry.

cargo.name: DNA / RNA
cargo.where: Associated nucleic-acid cargo; lumen placement schematic

cargo.name: PPAD / citrullinated proteins
cargo.where: Comparator evidence; not assigned to OMV-001

comparison.shared: Small rounded lipid-bound morphology can look similar at low detail.
comparison.omv: Bacterial outer-membrane origin; LPS and bacterial virulence cargo.
comparison.matrix: Host-derived mineralization vesicle; annexins and alkaline phosphatase in the cited VSMC study.
comparison.conclusion: Morphology alone cannot identify origin or prove calcifying function. No OMV-to-matrix-vesicle transformation is modeled.
